ci-bot: Pipeline main cluster failed immediately after merge (run: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/9876543). Failed step: integration-smoke-gpu
ci-bot: Summary: 12 tests failed, 4 flakes. Repeating error: "grpc_stream_timeout". Build: linux-gpu-3.2, commit: a1b2c3d4
sophie: Seen similar before — grpc timeouts often show up when the autoscaler or nodepool has a transient blip. @raja any infra alerts? :thinking:
raja: Autoscaler metrics look normal now, but there was a nodepool rollback ~6m ago. I'll pull the audit events and kube-controller logs.
matt: Logs from the test harness show repeated DeadlineExceeded from the RPC layer, snippet:
```
2026-03-17T09:15:12Z ERROR rpc_stream: DeadlineExceeded
  at src/runtime/transport.rs:287
  request id=12345
```
cheng: Which PR merged right before this? I see PR #4287 merged by @alaine about 2m before the run. Commit a1b2c3d4 touches grpc client timeout handling.
sophie: Can someone trigger a rerun for run 9876543? If it passes we lean flake, if not we bisect.
devops-scout: Rerun requested by @sophie: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/9876543/retry/1 (queued)
raja: While rerun is spinning up I'll review nodepool events and any scale-up latency.
oncall: @matt can you add the full list of failing tests so we can triage which area is the common denominator?
matt: Failing tests: tests/e2e/grpc_streaming_test.py::test_interleaved_streams, tests/serving/reconnect_test.py::test_reconnect_during_stream, tests/serving/timeouts_test.py::test_retry_behavior
sophie: Good call. If rerun stays red, I'll start a bisect across recent merges touching grpc/serving.
raja: Infra note: saw transient node allocation failure at 2026-03-17T09:12:41Z; scale-up request ACK delayed ~40s. Tagging that with the run.
devops-scout: Rerun finished: still red and same tests failing — https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/9876543/retry/1 (status: failed)
cheng: Ok starting bisect. @sophie can you kick off the bisect job against the merge window? Prioritize PRs touching grpc client/server.
sophie: Bisect job started: https://ci.redwood.ai/bisect/5533. I'll post the first suspect once we have results.
matt: Local quick repro: `pytest tests/e2e/grpc_streaming_test.py::test_interleaved_streams -k gpu -q` times out intermittently (~1/3 runs). Attaching local failure excerpt to the bisect job.
raja: I'm creating an infra incident ticket (SEV-2) to track nodepool allocation anomalies + CI failure correlation. Adding run ids and events.
sophie: Initial owner for the triage is @sophie. If anyone wants to take ownership of bisect/repro, please claim. :hand:
cheng: I'll help run bisect iterations and review a1b2c3d4 for suspicious timeout delta logic.
